metric_definition.binary_accuracy: Correct action decisions on actionable + non-action decisions on other classes, divided by scored rows.
metric_definition.unknown: Non-action for binary accuracy: correct on should-hold and incorrect on actionable. Never an explicit refusal.
metric_definition.error_policy: Historical missing-intent rows are excluded and counted separately; all six published arms have zero excluded errors. Errors are not relabeled UNKNOWN or credited as refusals.
metric_definition.scope: Router intent decisions, not observed effects or whole-system success.
metric_definition.rescoring_note: The original OOD runner used a different UNKNOWN accuracy convention. All six document arms are re-scored from preserved raw rows with the binary definition above, matching the executable English score.py calculation.

verification.classification_method: Historical second-AI source review of all 58 registry verifiers; per-entry inventory: 57 executed with synthetic inputs or substituted collaborators and 1 source-only (desktop.launch). These are not 57 full unmocked integration tests; the classification is historical and is not re-measured on current code.

ledger.measurement_scope: Historical stored statuses; reaching a verifier does not prove its verdict is independent.

published_figure_is_a_sample.truncated_flag_emitted_by: во моментот на мерењето: само aries/analytics/outcomes.py:135, не и integrity.py. Поправено по снимокот — види post_snapshot_repairs, наод F-13.

classification_evidence.recorded_method: Enumerated the 58 capabilities from the LIVE aries.workspace.registry.registry object (registry._items) and resolved each Capability.verifier to its defining file and line with inspect. Every verifier was then read in source, and 56 of 58 were EXECUTED directly with synthetic arguments - no database, no services, no models, nothing written under aries/ except this file. Where a verifier needed a collaborator (browser_read, desktop observe, the AT-SPI worker, systemctl show, nmcli, the screenshot re-inspect, path_for) that collaborator was replaced in the module namespace with a stub returning a known state; the file verifiers ran against real temporary files in the session scratchpad. Five read verifiers (file.list, file.search, system.status, system.storage, system.processes) were executed through the LIVE registered closure itself. Classification rule, applied mechanically to the `met` predicate: TRIVIAL = no reachable world state in which a wrong answer yields met=False (constant True, or a predicate that never touches the claim); PLANNER_SUPPLIED = the reference value is a free field of the model's arguments that it could set to the pre-action state; SELF_REPORT = met's only reference is the executor's own returned payload, so a no-op or an unchecked payload field passes; INDEPENDENT = met is a predicate over freshly re-read state compared against the request/goal arguments, a before/after invariant, or a digest of the returned content. Separately noted per capability: whose data becomes the stored evidence, because agent.py:74 records verifier['data'] (not the executor's result) and contracts.answer builds the user-facing answer from it.
classification_evidence.correction: Per-capability entries count 57 executed and 1 source-only. The original narrative count 56/58 is stale; executed checks include synthetic inputs and substituted collaborators.

post_snapshot_repairs.consequence_for_the_thesis: Предусловот за ниво 9 постоеше делумно кога беше мерено и постои поцелосно сега. Тврдењето мора да го носи датумот.

post_snapshot_note: Системот се поправаше додека овие документи се пишуваа. Тоа е посакуваниот исход од независен преглед и не е причина мерењето да се прикрие: секој наод носи снимок, а поправката се запишува покрај него. Статусот на наведените поправки е задржан од претходниот запис; не се проверува повторно врз живата инсталација при градењето.
